About Classic Sliding Puzzle

The Sliding Puzzle (also known as the 15 Puzzle) is a globally celebrated logic brain teaser. While the objective seems simple—rearranging a scrambled set of numbered tiles into numerical order—it requires a profound understanding of spatial logic, strategic planning, and fast hand-eye coordination. Now, you can enjoy this mind-bending classic free online directly in your browser!

Basic Rules & How to Play

The game board consists of a square grid filled with numbered tiles and exactly one empty space. The controls are intuitive:

  • Click or swipe any numbered tile adjacent to the empty space to slide it into that gap.
  • Use this single empty spot to continuously maneuver and rotate tiles within the confined space.
  • Your ultimate goal is to order all numbers from 1 in the top-left corner, running left-to-right and top-to-bottom, leaving the empty space in the bottom-right corner.

Advanced Speed-Solving Strategies

To solve the puzzle in record time, aimless moving won't work. Top speedcubers and puzzlers typically employ the \"Layer-by-Layer\" method:

  • Row by Row: Focus entirely on solving the top row first (e.g., tiles 1, 2, 3, 4). Once completed, never disturb this row again.
  • Column by Column: Next, solve the leftmost column, gradually shrinking the unsolved area of the board.
  • The Final Two Rows: When only the bottom two rows remain, treat them as a single rotational cycle. Rather than solving one row at a time, \"spin\" the tiles clockwise or counter-clockwise until they drop into their correct positions.

X-Game's Exclusive Multiplayer Speed PK

Tired of playing alone? We've completely revolutionized the sliding puzzle experience! Beyond offering Beginner (3x3), Intermediate (4x4), Advanced (5x5), and Expert (6x6) modes for solo training, we've introduced an adrenaline-pumping Real-time Multiplayer Speed Mode:

  • All players in the room face an identically scrambled board, ensuring a 100% fair and competitive environment.
  • Race against friends or players worldwide in real-time. The first player to slide all tiles into perfect order wins the match!
  • Supports Best-of-N series so you can prove who the true puzzle master is across multiple rounds.

Select your difficulty above, start sliding those tiles, and see if you can break the world record!

About Classic Sokoban (Push Box)

Sokoban is a brilliant gem in the history of puzzle games. Since its creation in the 1980s, its minimalist rules combined with mind-bendingly deep level designs have captivated millions worldwide. Far more than just a casual time-killer, it is a premier brain-training tool for developing spatial imagination, reverse logic, and holistic planning skills. Now, you can play this pure, classic warehouse puzzle game free online in your browser with zero downloads or ads.

Core Mechanics & How to Play

The game takes place in a confined, maze-like warehouse constructed of solid walls. You control a warehouse worker whose task is to meticulously push scattered boxes onto designated storage targets (usually marked with dots). The controls are intuitive, but the physics are unforgiving:

  • Push Only, No Pulling: This is the golden, often frustrating, rule of Sokoban. The worker can only apply forward force to a box. Once you push a box, you cannot grab it and pull it back.
  • One Box at a Time: The worker's strength is limited. If two or more boxes are adjacent in a line, they become too heavy to push together. You must find ways to separate them.
  • Beware of Dead Ends: Because you cannot pull boxes, pushing a box tightly into a corner, or forming an immovable 2x2 square of boxes, creates an instant \"deadlock.\" The puzzle becomes mathematically unsolvable, forcing a restart or undo.

Advanced Solving Strategies

When facing \"expert-level\" mazes crowded with dozens of boxes, trial and error will only lead to madness. True Sokoban masters rely on high-level cognitive strategies:

  • Reverse Engineering (Working Backwards): Stop thinking from the perspective of the worker! Instead, look at the final target dots. Mentally trace a box's path backwards from the target to its starting position, asking, \"From which direction must this box be pushed to end up here?\"
  • Traffic Control & Sequencing: Many mazes feature narrow bottlenecks. Pushing the wrong box into a corridor too early might permanently block the path for all other boxes. Determining the precise sequential order in which boxes must be stored is the key to victory.
  • Strategic Use of Undo: When facing a complex intersection, don't be afraid to experiment. Our game features a robust \"Unlimited Undo\" function, allowing you to backtrack step-by-step or instantly reset the level without fear of ruining your progress.

X-Game's Pioneering Multiplayer Arena

Tired of agonizing over puzzles in total isolation? We have broken Sokoban's traditional single-player curse by introducing a groundbreaking Real-Time Multiplayer PvP Mode:

  • Mirror Maze Racing: Invite your friends into a lobby where everyone faces the exact same daunting puzzle layout simultaneously. It's a frantic race to see whose brain can process the solution the fastest using the fewest steps!
  • Live Progress Tracking: During a multiplayer match, you can monitor your opponent's live progress bar (showing boxes successfully stored). The psychological pressure of seeing them pull ahead will push your adrenaline—and your logic—to the limit.

Stop hesitating! Select a difficulty level below and start pushing your brain to its maximum capacity!
game.hashi.seo_desc:
About Hashi (Hashiwokakero / Bridges)

Hashi, formally known as Hashiwokakero and commonly referred to as Bridges, is a fiercely engaging logic puzzle originating from Japan. Much like Sudoku, it requires absolutely no mathematical calculations. Instead, it tests your deductive reasoning, spatial planning, and topological logic. Your mission is to connect a scattered archipelago of numbered islands using a network of bridges, creating a single, fully interconnected system. Play free online Hashi right here in your browser and push your logical deduction skills to their limits.

Core Rules & Construction Laws

The puzzle is played on a rectangular grid with various circular \"islands,\" each displaying a number. You draw bridges between these islands by clicking, but you must strictly adhere to the following laws of physics:

  • Number Matching: The total number of bridges connected to a specific island must exactly match the number written on that island.
  • Double Bridge Limit: You can build at most two bridges (a single or a double bridge) between any two specific islands.
  • Straight Lines Only: Bridges can only run horizontally or vertically. Most importantly, bridges can never cross each other, nor can they cross over an island.
  • Global Interconnection: The most critical and often overlooked rule—when the puzzle is finished, you must be able to travel from any island to any other island in the puzzle by walking over the bridges. No isolated sub-groups or \"closed loops\" are allowed!

Advanced Deduction Patterns

Guessing is a recipe for disaster on larger Hashi boards. True puzzle masters rely on guaranteed logic patterns:

  • The Corner 4 & The Edge 6: An island with a \"4\" in the very corner of the board only has two valid directions. Therefore, it is mathematically forced to have two double-bridges. Similarly, an edge \"6\" and a center \"8\" must have double bridges extending in every possible direction.
  • The Corner 3 & The Edge 5: A corner \"3\" must connect to its two available neighbors with at least one bridge each. Drawing these \"guaranteed\" single bridges early on provides a solid foundation for further deductions.
  • Isolation Prevention (The Loop Rule): Always be careful not to prematurely connect two \"1\" islands together, or connect two \"2\" islands with a double bridge. Doing so creates an isolated, closed-off circuit, violating the Global Interconnection rule. You can use this restriction to logically prove that certain bridges cannot exist.

X-Game's Pioneering Multiplayer Hashi

Tired of solving logic puzzles in solitude? We've transformed this classic solitary game with our revolutionary Real-Time Multiplayer Bridges Mode (PvP):

  • All players in the lobby are faced with the exact same intricately designed island map, ensuring a perfectly level playing field.
  • It's a high-stakes race against the clock and your opponents! The first player to flawlessly satisfy all island conditions and connect the entire network wins.
  • Utilize our smart highlighting system, which automatically visually confirms when an island's capacity is met, allowing you to maintain a blistering pace under competitive pressure.

Choose your difficulty level above and start building your bridge network today!
game.block.seo_desc:
About Block Puzzle (Tetris-Style Jigsaw)

Block Puzzle is a wildly popular modern casual game that brilliantly merges the geometric satisfaction of classic Tetris with the stress-free freedom of a drag-and-drop jigsaw puzzle. By stripping away the anxiety-inducing gravity and relentless time limits of traditional falling-block games, it offers a purely zen yet deeply strategic experience. Dive into the immensely satisfying flow of spatial organization and explosive line clears directly in your browser, completely free and with zero downloads required!

Core Mechanics: Zero-Gravity Geometry

The game is played on an 8x8 or 10x10 square grid. Beneath the board, the system will continuously generate sets of three random block shapes (ranging from classic Tetris tetrominoes like the L, T, and I pieces to massive 3x3 squares).

  • Drag, Drop, But Never Rotate: You control the game by dragging a shape from the dock and dropping it onto any open space on the grid. The hardcore catch is that blocks cannot be rotated under any circumstances! You must accommodate them exactly as they are dealt to you.
  • Dual-Axis Clearing: Unlike Tetris which only clears horizontal lines, Block Puzzle allows you to clear lines both horizontally and vertically. Once a full row or column is completely filled with blocks, it shatters instantly, rewarding you with points and freeing up crucial board space.
  • Sudden Death: There is no ticking clock, but space is your most precious resource. The game ends immediately the moment you cannot fit ANY of the three currently available shapes into the remaining empty gaps on your board.

Pro Strategy: The Art of Spatial Management

If you want to shatter your high scores and climb the global leaderboards, careless placement will quickly lead to a \"Game Over.\" True Block Puzzle masters employ advanced spatial tactics:

  • Fear the 3x3 Giant: Always strive to keep a completely clean 3x3 grid area open somewhere on your board. The random number generator loves to punish players by dropping the massive 3x3 square block at the worst possible times. If you haven't reserved a \"parking spot\" for it, you will die instantly.
  • The Cross-Combo Setup: Don't settle for single-line clears. Elite players intentionally build up overlapping unfinished rows and columns. When the perfect corner or line piece arrives, placing it will simultaneously complete a row and a column, triggering a spectacular Cross-Combo that yields massive bonus points!
  • Plan Three Steps Ahead: Never place a piece without considering its two companions in the dock. You must mentally simulate the placement order of all three pieces before committing to your first move to ensure you don't accidentally blockade yourself.

Breaking the Solitude: Multiplayer PvP Block Battles

Think Block Puzzle is just a relaxing solo game? We've turned it into a heart-pounding competitive arena with our exclusive Real-Time Multiplayer PvP Mode:

  • Face off against friends or worldwide opponents. Both players receive the exact same agonizing sequence of block shapes (synchronized RNG) to ensure a 100% fair battle of wits.
  • Garbage Line Attacks: This is where it gets vicious! When you execute impressive Multi-Line clears or Consecutive Combos, you send un-clearable \"Gray Garbage Blocks\" pushing up from the bottom of your opponent's board, brutally choking their available space.
  • It's a relentless test of spatial logic and nerves. Out-think, out-clear, and outlast your opponent to claim victory!

Are you ready to organize your grid and crush those blocks? Click play above and start your puzzle journey now!
game.codebreaker.seo_desc:
About Classic Codebreaker (Mastermind)

Codebreaker is a deeply challenging and highly addictive logic and deduction puzzle game, heavily inspired by the globally beloved board game Mastermind (and closely related to the classic 1A2B Bulls and Cows game). In this ultimate test of logical reasoning, you step into the shoes of an elite hacker. Your mission is to deduce a hidden sequence of colored pegs within a limited number of attempts, using only the cryptic clues provided by the system. Play free online directly in your browser—no downloads needed!

Basic Rules & The Clue System

At the start of the game, the system generates a secret code consisting of a sequence of colors. You must place your guess in the current row and submit it. The system will then evaluate your guess and provide critical feedback using feedback pegs:

  • Black Pegs (Bulls / Exact Matches): Indicates that one of your guessed colors is not only in the secret code, but it is also placed in the exact correct position.
  • White Pegs (Cows / Partial Matches): Indicates that one of your guessed colors exists in the secret code, but it is currently placed in the wrong position.
  • Empty Spaces: Meaning a guessed color does not exist in the secret code at all.

Crucial Note: The order of the feedback pegs (black and white) does NOT correspond to the positions of the colors you guessed. You must use pure logic to deduce which peg applies to which color!

Advanced Deduction Strategies

To crack the code in the fewest possible moves, wild guessing won't cut it. Master codebreakers rely on strict elimination strategies:

  • The Opening Gambit: High-level players often start with a combination of completely distinct colors (e.g., ABCD) to quickly discover which colors are in play. Another popular opening is AABB, which mathematically helps to quickly filter out large chunks of the candidate pool.
  • Hypothesis Testing: If you receive \"1 Black, 1 White\", you must form a mental hypothesis (or use in-game notes). Assume one specific color is the \"Black\" peg and logically test if the remaining colors can satisfy the \"White\" peg condition without contradicting previous clues.
  • Utilizing \"Dead\" Colors: Don't just focus on the right colors! Colors you have proven to NOT be in the code are incredibly valuable as \"placeholders.\" You can use them in subsequent guesses to isolate and test the exact position of a single suspect color.

X-Game's Exclusive Multiplayer Speedrun

Solving puzzles alone is fun, but we've taken Mastermind to the next level with our exclusive Real-Time Multiplayer Speedrun Mode:

  • Fair Competition: Everyone in the lobby is tasked with cracking the exact same secret code simultaneously.
  • Brain vs. Speed: It’s not just about deducing the answer—it's about doing it faster than your opponent under intense pressure. The first player to successfully crack the code steals the win!
  • Scalable Difficulty: From the welcoming \"4 pegs, no duplicates\" beginner mode, all the way to the nightmare-inducing \"6 pegs, duplicates allowed\" expert mode, we have a challenge for every caliber of logic enthusiast.

Are you ready to put your IQ to the ultimate test? Select your difficulty above and start breaking the code!
game.drop2048.seo_desc:
About Drop 2048 (Tetris 2048)

Drop 2048 is an incredibly addictive and innovative puzzle game that brilliantly fuses the falling-block mechanics of Tetris with the number-merging logic of classic 2048. Unlike traditional 2048 which allows for slow, deliberate planning, Drop 2048 demands rapid spatial awareness and split-second reflexes as numbers continuously rain from above. Play free online directly in your browser and experience the ultimate satisfaction of explosive number chains!

Core Mechanics & Merging Rules

As the game begins, blocks featuring base numbers (like 2, 4, or 8) will continuously fall from the top of the grid. Your objective is to move these blocks left or right and drop them into the optimal columns:

  • Same-Number Merging: When a falling block lands on or adjacent to another block with the exact same number, they instantly fuse into a single block with double the value (e.g., two 8s merge into a 16; two 1024s merge into a 2048).
  • Chain Reactions (Combos): This is where the game shines. A successful merge may cause the blocks stacked above it to fall further down. If they land on matching numbers, it triggers a cascading chain reaction of automatic merges!
  • Survival Rule: If your columns of blocks stack too high and cross the danger line at the top of the board, it's Game Over.

Advanced Strategies for High Scores

To dominate the global leaderboards, you cannot just drop blocks randomly. You must master the \"Number Pyramid\" stacking strategy:

  • Keep Big Numbers at the Bottom: Always strive to keep your highest synthesized numbers (like 512 or 1024) buried at the very bottom of the grid. If a small number gets trapped beneath a large number, that column becomes dead weight.
  • Staircase Layout: Arrange your numbers in a descending sequential order (e.g., 64, 32, 16, 8) either vertically or horizontally. When a new 8 drops in, it will trigger a satisfying domino effect: 8->16->32->64->128!
  • Look Ahead: Never just watch the current falling block. Always keep an eye on the \"Next Block\" preview to leave a strategic gap for upcoming numbers.

X-Game's Exclusive Multiplayer Battles

Tired of just beating your own high score? We have introduced a revolutionary Real-Time Multiplayer PvP Mode:

  • Face off against your friends or players worldwide in a shared lobby.
  • Garbage Attacks: When you execute massive Chain Reactions or merge exceptionally high numbers, you send un-mergeable \"Garbage Blocks\" straight to your opponent's board, pushing their stack closer to the ceiling of death.
  • It's a fast-paced test of offensive combos and desperate defensive survival. Only the fastest mind wins!

Ready to brave the falling numbers? Hit play and push your merging limits to the max!
game.classic2048.seo_desc:
About Classic 2048 (Number Puzzle)

2048 is a phenomenal sliding block puzzle game that took the internet by storm. Beneath its deceptively simple mechanics lies a bottomless depth of mathematical logic and spatial geometry. Often hailed as the ultimate \"digital addiction,\" it provides endless hours of brain-training entertainment. Play the purest, ad-free 4x4 classic version right here in your browser, and experience the sheer dopamine rush of exponentially doubling your numbers.

Core Mechanics & Spawning Rules

The game takes place on a minimalist 4x4 grid. You navigate using arrow keys on a desktop or by swiping on a touchscreen:

  • With every swipe (Up, Down, Left, or Right), all tiles on the board will slide as far as possible in that chosen direction.
  • During the slide, if two tiles bearing the exact same number collide, they will seamlessly merge into a single tile with double the original value (e.g., two 4s become an 8; two 512s become a 1024).
  • After every valid move, a new, small tile (a 2, or rarely a 4) will spawn in a random empty spot on the grid. If the board fills up completely and no more merges are possible, the game is over.

Advanced Strategies: Reaching 2048 and Beyond

Many beginners find themselves hopelessly stuck around 512 or 1024. Breaking through to 2048 requires strict adherence to high-level strategic patterns:

  • The Corner Strategy: This is the golden rule of 2048. Pick a specific corner of the grid (for example, the bottom-right corner) and park your absolute highest-valued tile there. Never let it leave that corner!
  • The Snake Pattern (Chain Rule): Build your tiles in a descending, snake-like formation starting from your highest corner tile. For instance, if 1024 is in the bottom-right, place 512 to its left, 256 left of that, and loop back around. When a small number at the tail end merges, it triggers a massive zipper-like chain reaction all the way up to your largest tile.
  • Direction Ban: To keep your highest tile safely anchored in its corner, you must permanently avoid pressing the directional key that pulls it away. If your anchor is in the bottom-right, you must rarely, if ever, press \"Up\" or \"Left.\"

Pioneering Real-Time Multiplayer 2048

  • Challenge your friends or global players in a synchronized race for the highest score.

About Classic Gomoku (Five in a Row)

Gomoku, also known as Five in a Row, is an ancient strategy board game that originated in China. Famous for being \"easy to learn, hard to master,\" it is an exceptional mental exercise that sharpens your strategic vision, logical deduction, and defensive counter-attacking skills. Play free online Gomoku directly in your browser and enjoy the purest form of tactical combat without the need for a physical board.

Basic Rules & How to Play

The game is traditionally played on a 15x15 grid intersection board. The player wielding the Black stones moves first, followed by the player with the White stones. The victory condition is brutally simple:

  • Connect Five: The first player to form an unbroken chain of exactly five stones horizontally, vertically, or diagonally wins the game instantly.
  • Standard Free-style Rules: To accommodate casual players worldwide, our standard lobbies use free-style rules without complicated restrictions (such as Renju bans), meaning overlines (six or more stones) are also accepted as winning conditions.

Advanced Tactical Strategies

To dominate the Gomoku board, merely focusing on your own lines is a recipe for defeat. True masters utilize forced moves and double-threat tactics:

  • Open Threes and Closed Fours: An \"Open Three\" is a line of three stones with both ends unblocked; if ignored, it guarantees a win. A \"Closed Four\" (or straight four) is a line of four blocked on one end, forcing the opponent's immediate response.
  • Double Threats (Forks): The core path to victory. By placing a single stone, a player creates two simultaneous, unanswerable threats—such as a Double Three (two intersecting open threes) or a Four-Three. The opponent can only block one, securing your win on the next turn.
  • VCF (Victory by Continuous Fours): A spectacular advanced technique where a player executes a relentless sequence of forced \"Fours,\" forcing the opponent to passively block every single turn until the final winning move is placed.

X-Game's Premium Online Experience

Beyond our powerful built-in AI, which scales from \"Beginner\" to \"Grandmaster\" for offline training, we pride ourselves on a flawless Real-Time Multiplayer (PvP) Experience:

  • Cross-Platform Duels: Instantly generate a room code and invite friends playing on mobile, tablet, or desktop for a seamless, lag-free match.
  • Match History & Spectator Mode: Review your past games move-by-move to analyze your mistakes, or jump into live matches to spectate top players and learn new opening strategies.
  • Ranked Matchmaking: (Coming soon) Our Elo-based matchmaking system will pair you against opponents of equal skill, ensuring every match is a thrilling battle of wits.

Hexa Puzzle is a visually striking and mentally stimulating block elimination game that completely revolutionizes the genre. Unlike traditional square-grid games (like Tetris), the honeycomb-style hexagonal grid introduces an unprecedented three dimensions of elimination. This unique geometry grants players immense freedom but demands exceptional spatial imagination and holistic board management. Dive into the immensely satisfying experience of locking blocks into place and triggering explosive chain reactions, completely free and ad-free right in your browser!

Core Mechanics & The 3-Axis Elimination

The game takes place on a large, master hexagonal honeycomb board. Beneath the board, the system will randomly generate three distinct block shapes built from smaller hexagons.

  • Drag and Drop: You must physically drag these shapes and place them onto the empty spaces of the board. Crucially, these shapes cannot be rotated. You must figure out how to fit them exactly as they are presented.
  • Omnidirectional Clearing: When you successfully fill an unbroken, straight line across the board in any of the three directions (horizontal, top-left-to-bottom-right diagonal, or top-right-to-bottom-left diagonal), that line violently shatters, rewarding you with points and freeing up precious real estate.
  • Survival Rule: The game ends instantly if you cannot find a valid open space to fit ANY of the three shapes waiting in your queue.

Pro Strategies: Mastering Honeycomb Space

If you want to dominate the global leaderboards, simply plugging holes won't cut it. You must master the art of advanced spatial management:

  • The Edge-First Principle: Always try to anchor large, awkwardly shaped blocks along the outer edges and corners of the board. Protect the central core of the board at all costs! The center is where all three elimination axes intersect, making it the most vital area for late-game maneuvers.
  • Setting Up Combos: Don't clear a single line just because you can. Elite players intentionally leave a single hexagon \"choke point\" empty, building up multiple nearly-finished lines around it. When the perfect piece arrives, placing it triggers a massive Multi-Line Combo, clearing massive sections of the board and multiplying your score exponentially.
  • Prioritize the Beasts: Always evaluate the three shapes you are given. If you see a massive, unwieldy piece (like a giant triangle or a long straight line), you must place it immediately before your board gets too cluttered.

X-Game's Exclusive Multiplayer Survival

Who says block puzzles have to be a solitary experience? We've shattered the mold with our adrenaline-fueled Real-Time Multiplayer PvP Survival Mode:

  • Face off against friends or global rivals in a shared lobby. Everyone receives the exact same agonizing sequence of random blocks.
  • Garbage Block Attacks: The ultimate twist! When you execute brilliant Multi-Line clears or Consecutive Combos, the system rains un-clearable \"Gray Garbage Hexagons\" onto your opponent's board, suffocating their available space.
  • Survive the onslaught! Only the player with the clearest spatial vision and the strongest nerves will outlast the competition and claim victory.

Stop hesitating! Click play above and put your spatial geometry skills to the ultimate test!
game.idiom.seo_desc:
About Chinese Idiom Solitaire (Chengyu Crossword)

Idiom Solitaire (also known as Chengyu Crossword) is a fascinating educational word game that deeply integrates the essence of traditional Chinese cultural heritage with modern crossword puzzle mechanics. It is not merely a challenging brain-teaser, but a living, interactive dictionary of Chinese idioms (Chengyu). Forget rote memorization—immerse yourself in the profound beauty of Chinese characters and historical anecdotes directly in your browser. No downloads required!

Core Mechanics & Puzzle Rules

The game board consists of multiple interlocking four-character grid spaces. The system will provide several Chinese characters as initial clues. Your task is to select the correct characters from the candidate pool below and fill in the blanks:

  • Crossword Logic (Intersections): When two idioms cross paths on the board, they share a pivotal Chinese character. This intersecting node is often the critical breakthrough point to solving the puzzle!
  • Two-Way Verification: Every character you place must form a grammatically correct, officially recognized four-character Chengyu in both the horizontal and vertical directions. Creating non-existent phrases is not allowed.
  • Strategic Hints: Encountered an obscure historical idiom? Utilize the in-game \"Hint\" to instantly reveal a character, or use the \"Eliminate\" function to remove useless decoy characters from your candidate pool.

Advanced Solving Strategies & Cultural Learning

Clearing a massive, complex board quickly requires more than just a large vocabulary; it requires tactical deduction:

  • Finding the Breakthrough: Always attack the idioms that already have the most characters revealed or have the highest density of intersections. Solving the common idioms you already know will automatically unlock clues for the more difficult, obscure ones.
  • Linguistic Deduction: Chinese idioms often feature strict parallel structures (e.g., matching nouns to nouns, verbs to verbs). By analyzing the grammatical context of the missing blank, you can drastically narrow down your character choices.
  • Learn While Playing: Upon completing a level, the game provides comprehensive Pinyin, detailed definitions, and the historical origins for every single idiom on the board. It is the ultimate immersive tool for elevating your Chinese literary proficiency.

Pioneering Multiplayer Speed-Word Battles

Consider yourself a master of Chinese literature? Put your vocabulary to the test in our exclusive Real-Time Multiplayer Speed-Word Mode:

  • All players in the lobby are presented with the exact same massive, interconnected idiom grid.
  • It's a frantic race! Players simultaneously fill in blanks, capturing points for every correct character placed.

Ready to challenge your vocabulary? Click above to start your cultural puzzle journey today!
game.lightsout.seo_desc:
About Classic Lights Out

Lights Out is a legendary electronic logic puzzle game that became a global phenomenon in the 1990s. Despite its incredibly simple core mechanic, it generates mind-bogglingly complex board states. Underneath its casual exterior, Lights Out is actually a profound mathematical problem rooted in linear algebra (specifically GF(2) mathematics) and topology, making it a beloved challenge among math enthusiasts and programmers. Play this pure, ad-free brain teaser directly in your browser and see if you can plunge the grid into darkness in the fewest possible moves!

Core Mechanics & The Cross-Toggle Rule

The game is traditionally played on a 5x5 grid of lights. At the start of a level, a random pattern of lights is switched on. Your ultimate objective is brutally clear: Turn off every single light on the board.

  • The Cross Toggle: This is the only action in the game, and it causes all the chaos. When you click on any lightbulb, it toggles its own state (from ON to OFF, or OFF to ON). Crucially, the four adjacent lights (directly above, below, left, and right) will also toggle their states simultaneously!
  • Edge and Corner Cases: If you click a light on the edge or in the corner of the grid, only the adjacent lights that actually exist on the board will be affected (e.g., clicking a corner toggles 3 lights total).
  • Order Doesn't Matter: Mathematically, the order in which you click the lights does not affect the final outcome. Furthermore, clicking the same light twice is equivalent to never clicking it at all. Thus, the perfect solution requires clicking any specific light a maximum of one time.

Advanced Strategy: \"Chasing the Lights\"

Randomly clicking lights in hopes of clearing the board will only lead to frustration. True puzzle masters employ a systematic algorithm known as \"Chasing the Lights\":

  • Sweep from Top to Bottom: Start at the very top row. For every light that is currently ON in the first row, click the light directly below it in the second row. This uses the upward toggle effect to cleanly extinguish the entire first row.
  • Chase to the Bottom: Repeat this process row by row. Use row 3 to turn off row 2, and row 4 to turn off row 3, effectively \"chasing\" all the illuminated lights down to the very bottom row (row 5).
  • The Bottom Row Lookup: Once only the bottom row has lights remaining, you observe the specific pattern of those lights. Based on that pattern, you must click specific lights in the first row again, and then repeat the \"Chase\" process one final time. Done correctly, the entire board goes black!

X-Game's Exclusive Multiplayer Speedrun

Solving linear algebra alone can feel isolating, so we revolutionized the classic formula with our thrilling Real-Time Multiplayer Speedrun Mode:

  • Join a lobby where all players are confronted with the exact same randomized, guaranteed-solvable starting grid.
  • It’s a frantic race of logic, visual processing, and clicking speed! The first player to successfully extinguish their entire board claims the victory.
  • Scale the difficulty from a breezy 3x3 grid up to a nightmare-inducing 7x7 grid to truly test your cognitive limits.

Are you ready to embrace the dark? Click play above and start chasing those lights!
game.math24.seo_desc:
About Classic Math 24

Math 24 (or the 24 Game) is a globally renowned arithmetical card game and logic puzzle. What once started as a fun classroom and family tabletop game has now been perfectly recreated for the digital age. It serves as an exceptional educational tool for students to enhance mental math and number sense, while also providing adults with a stimulating brain workout to stay sharp. Play free online directly in your browser—no downloads required!

Basic Rules & How to Play

The objective is straightforward: use four randomly generated numbers and basic arithmetic operations to reach a final result of exactly 24. The specific rules are:

  • The Four Operators: You may use addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (×), division (÷), and parentheses to control the order of operations.
  • Use All Numbers: Each of the four provided numbers must be used exactly once. You cannot leave any numbers out.
  • Fractions Allowed: Intermediate steps can result in fractions or decimals (e.g., 5 ÷ 4), as long as the final calculation perfectly evaluates to the integer 24.

Speed-Solving Techniques & Strategies

To spot the solution in mere seconds, mastering common arithmetic patterns is essential. Here are some strategies used by Math 24 experts:

  • Target 3×8 or 4×6: This is the most common approach. Check if you have a 3, 4, 6, or 8, and then try to manipulate the remaining three numbers to form the missing multiplier.
  • Addition and Subtraction: If multiplication isn't working, try to hit numbers close to 24 and adjust. For example, creating 25 - 1 = 24, or 12 + 12 = 24.
  • The Fraction Trick: For the most notoriously difficult puzzles (like the classic 3, 3, 8, 8), utilizing fractions is the only way out. The brilliant solution 8 ÷ (3 - 8 ÷ 3) = 24 separates the masters from the beginners!

X-Game's Exclusive Feature: Multiplayer Mental Math Battles

Tired of solving puzzles alone? We have built a unique and thrilling Real-Time Multiplayer Buzzer Mode:

  • Fair Competition: All players in the lobby face the exact same set of four numbers simultaneously, ensuring a completely level playing field.
  • Extreme Speed: The first person to mentally calculate the answer and submit the correct formula snatches the points for that round! It's an intense test of both computational speed and performance under pressure.
  • Dynamic Difficulty Algorithm: Our puzzle generator guarantees that every set has a valid solution and dynamically adjusts the difficulty based on player skill—ranging from easy \"one-glance\" puzzles to absolute brain-melters.

Click play above, put your mathematical intuition to the test, and prove you are the ultimate mental math champion!
game.minesweeper.seo_desc:
About Classic Minesweeper

Minesweeper is a globally beloved logic puzzle game that became a household name alongside the rise of personal computers. It perfectly blends rigorous logical deduction with thrilling probability judgment, making it an excellent choice for sharpening your brain's reaction speed and spatial reasoning. Here, you can play free online Minesweeper directly in your browser with no downloads required.

Basic Rules & How to Play

The objective is to clear a rectangular board containing hidden mines without detonating any of them, with help from clues about the number of neighboring mines in each field. Basic controls include:

  • Left Click (or Tap): Reveal a square. If it's a mine, you lose instantly! If it's a number (1-8), it tells you exactly how many mines are hidden in the surrounding 3x3 area.
  • Right Click (or Long Press): Place a Flag on a square you suspect is a mine to prevent accidental clicks.
  • Chording (Double Click or Left+Right Click): Once a number has the correct amount of flags surrounding it, you can chord it to instantly reveal all remaining unflagged adjacent squares, drastically improving your sweeping speed.

Advanced Minesweeper Strategies

To become a true bomb disposal expert, mastering common logic patterns is essential:

  • The 1-1 Pattern: When you see two 1s adjacent to each other against a flat wall of unrevealed squares, you can often deduce that certain squares away from them are completely safe.
  • The 1-2-1 Pattern: When you encounter a 1-2-1 line, the mines are always located exactly next to the two 1s.
  • The 1-2-2-1 Pattern: This usually means the two squares directly in front of the 2s are mines. You can confidently place two flags.

X-Game's Exclusive Multiplayer Minesweeper

Beyond offering the classic Beginner (9x9), Intermediate (16x16), Expert (30x16), and Custom single-player modes, we have completely revolutionized the game with groundbreaking multiplayer arenas:

  • Steal Mode: All players in the room clash on the exact same giant board! Deduce mine locations and race to flag them for points. But beware: falsely flagging a safe square will hit you with a harsh time-freeze penalty!
  • Speed Mode: A fair duel on identical but independent boards. The first player to safely reveal all non-mine squares wins. Features intelligent \"First-Click Protection,\" ensuring you never explode on your very first move.

Whether you want to relive a nostalgic classic or challenge your friends to an adrenaline-pumping mine-clearing battle, choose your difficulty above and start sweeping now!
game.sudoku.seo_desc:
About Classic Sudoku

Sudoku is a globally popular number-placement puzzle game. It requires no complex mathematics, relying entirely on logical deduction, making it an excellent brain workout and a great way to improve concentration. Whether you want to relax your mind during your free time or push the limits of your logical thinking, playing free online Sudoku offers the ultimate puzzle-solving joy.

Basic Rules & How to Play

A standard Sudoku board consists of a 9x9 grid, divided into nine 3x3 subgrids (blocks). Your objective is to fill the empty cells with digits from 1 to 9, satisfying the following three conditions simultaneously:

  • Each Row: Must contain all digits from 1 to 9 exactly once, with no repetitions.
  • Each Column: Must contain all digits from 1 to 9 exactly once, with no repetitions.
  • Each 3x3 Block: Must contain all digits from 1 to 9 exactly once, with no repetitions.

Advanced Solving Strategies

To become a Sudoku master, basic intuition is often not enough. Here are a few advanced solving techniques you can practice using our in-game \"Notes\" feature:

  • Naked Single: If a cell is surrounded by 8 different numbers in its row, column, and block, the only remaining number must be placed in that cell.
  • Hidden Single: Within a specific row, column, or block, if a number can only be placed in one specific cell (because all other empty cells are blocked by the same number in intersecting rows/columns), it must be placed there.
  • Naked Pairs: If two cells in the same row, column, or block contain exactly the same two candidate numbers, those numbers must occupy those two cells. You can safely remove these two candidates from all other cells in that unit.

Innovative Features on X-Game

We provide more than just the traditional solo training mode (featuring four difficulty levels from Beginner to Expert, all guaranteed to have a unique solution). We have pioneered Real-time Multiplayer PK Modes:

  • Speed Mode: Invite friends to a room where everyone faces the exact same puzzle board. Race against time to see whose logic and speed are superior. The first to 100% correctly solve the puzzle wins!
  • Steal Mode: All players share the exact same board. You gain points for correct placements, but incorrect placements will result in a time-freeze penalty. It transforms a solitary puzzle into an adrenaline-pumping competitive arena.

Ready for the challenge? Select a difficulty above and let the brainstorming begin!
game.tetris.seo_desc:
About Classic Tetris

Tetris is the undisputed king of evergreen classic video games, captivating the world since its creation. Through the simple yet addictive mechanics of falling geometric blocks, it has built the childhood memories of millions. It is widely recognized as one of the best games for improving spatial imagination, hand-eye coordination, and split-second reaction times. Play the authentic Tetris experience free online in your browser—no emulator downloads required!

Basic Rules & Mechanics

The core gameplay revolves around manipulating 7 different shapes of Tetrominoes as they fall into the playing field (the Matrix). Your goal is to arrange them to form complete, solid horizontal lines at the bottom. When a line is filled, it clears and you earn points. As your score climbs, the gravity speed increases until the stack reaches the top, resulting in a Game Over (Top Out).

  • Soft Drop & Hard Drop: In addition to basic lateral movement and rotation, you can use \"Soft Drop\" to accelerate a piece downwards, or \"Hard Drop\" to instantly lock it at the bottom, drastically increasing your playing speed.
  • The Hold Queue: Stumble upon a piece you don't need right now? Swap it into the \"Hold\" box and save it for a critical moment. This is a lifesaver when you're in trouble or waiting to execute a massive clear.
  • Next Queue: Always keep an eye on the upcoming pieces shown on the side. Planning your placements ahead of time is the hallmark of a seasoned player.

Advanced Scoring Strategies

To dominate the global leaderboards, you must master advanced clearing techniques that yield massive score multipliers:

  • The Tetris Line Clear: Intentionally leave a single vertical column open and build your stack high. When the long I-Piece arrives, drop it in to clear 4 lines simultaneously for massive points.
  • T-Spins: The pinnacle of modern Tetris gameplay. This involves rotating a T-Piece at the very last moment into a tight slot that it seemingly couldn't fall into normally. T-Spins grant massive hidden score bonuses.
  • Back-to-Back & Combos: Chaining difficult clears (like back-to-back Tetrises or T-Spins) or maintaining an unbroken streak of consecutive line clears will trigger devastating score multipliers.

Intense Multiplayer Battles: The Garbage Wars

Tired of chasing high scores alone? X-Game brings you an adrenaline-pumping Real-Time Multiplayer Battle Mode:

  • Face off against your friends in a shared room. Every time you clear 2 or more lines simultaneously, you send \"Garbage Lines\" to the bottom of your opponent's board, pushing their stack closer to the deadly ceiling!
  • Mastering T-Spins and Combos allows you to unleash devastating garbage spikes that can instantly KO an opponent.
  • Prove your resilience in Best-of-N series, where clutch defenses and lightning-fast counterattacks define the true champion.

Ready to brave the falling blocks? Hit the play button above and start clearing lines!
game.watersort.seo_desc:
About Water Sort Puzzle

Water Sort Puzzle is a globally beloved, stress-relieving casual game that brilliantly disguises complex combinatorial logic behind the incredibly satisfying act of pouring colored liquids. Watching chaotic, mixed-up tubes gradually transform into beautifully pure, solid colors offers unparalleled psychological satisfaction and a deep sense of order. Play this highly addictive, brain-soothing puzzle directly in your browser with no downloads or installation required!

Core Mechanics & The Laws of Pouring

At the start of each level, you are presented with several glass tubes containing layers of different colored water, alongside one or two completely empty tubes. Your ultimate goal is to strategically pour the water between tubes until every single tube contains only one solid color. However, you must strictly obey these laws of physics:

  • Color Matching Only: You can only pour water into a target tube if the top layer of water in that tube is the exact same color as the water you are pouring. You can never pour water on top of a different color.
  • Volume Limits: Each tube has a strict maximum capacity (usually holding exactly four units of water). You cannot pour water into a tube that is already completely full.
  • The Empty Tube Privilege: An entirely empty tube is your wild card. You can pour any color of water into a fully empty tube.

Advanced Strategies & Preventing Deadlocks

As you progress to expert levels with dozens of tubes and colors, pouring randomly will quickly lead to a \"deadlock\" where no more valid moves are possible. Master these strategies to keep the liquid flowing:

  • Empty Tube Management: Empty tubes are your most precious resource—do not squander them! Treat them as critical transit hubs. Focus your early efforts on consolidating colors to completely empty out a single tube. Gaining an extra empty tube exponentially increases your maneuvering space.
  • Reverse Engineering (Bottom-Up Logic): Don't just stare at the top layers. A true sorting master constantly analyzes the colors buried at the very bottom of the tubes. Plan your pours specifically to \"unearth\" these trapped colors, ensuring you don't get stuck later in the game.
  • Strategic Use of Undo: When you hit a wall, don't instantly hit restart. Our game features a generous \"Undo\" button. Backtrack a few steps and try an alternate branching path. The solution is often just one slightly different pour away.

X-Game's Exclusive Multiplayer Speed Sorting

Is sorting water too relaxing for you? We've cranked up the intensity by inventing the world's first Real-Time Multiplayer Speed Sorting Mode (PvP):

  • Synchronized Chaos: All players in the lobby are presented with the exact same brutally difficult, randomized starting tubes.
  • Brain vs. Speed: It is no longer just about finding the solution; it's a frantic race against the clock and your opponents! The first player to successfully sort all the colors into pure tubes steals the victory.
  • The psychological pressure of seeing your opponent nearing completion frequently causes even veteran players to make fatal pouring mistakes, making it an incredibly thrilling spectator experience!

Take a deep breath, relax your mind, and click play above to start sorting those colors!

# Privacy Policy

**Effective Date: June 2026**

Welcome to Puzzle PK. Your privacy is critically important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website, games, and related services.

## 1. Information We Collect

We strive to collect only the absolute minimum amount of data required to operate the platform.

* **Account Information**: When you register, we collect a username and a securely hashed password. We do not require your real name or email address for basic gameplay.
* **Gameplay Data**: We store your high scores, game progress, match history, and unlocked achievements so you can track improvement over time.
* **Technical Data**: We temporarily log your IP address and connection timestamps solely for the purpose of maintaining server stability, preventing DDoS attacks, and ensuring fair play during real-time multiplayer matches (PK mode).

## 2. How We Use Your Information

* To provide, maintain, and improve our gaming platform.
* To manage your user account and authenticate your logins securely.
* To display global leaderboards and matchmaking rankings.
* To detect and prevent cheating, abuse, or other violations of our Terms of Service.
* To send you important service-related notifications (we do not send marketing emails).

## 3. Data Sharing and Disclosure

We **do not** sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. Your data is strictly used for operating Puzzle PK. We may share anonymous, aggregated gameplay statistics (e.g., "10,000 matches of Sudoku played today") publicly, but this will never contain identifiable information.

## 4. Advertising & Google AdSense Cookies

To keep our games **100% free**, Puzzle PK displays advertisements provided by **Google AdSense** and other third-party advertising networks.

**How it works:**
* Google AdSense uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your visits to this and other websites in order to show you relevant advertisements.
* The **DoubleClick cookie** and other advertising cookies may be set by Google on your device when you visit our site. These cookies track which ads you have seen and allow Google to serve ads tailored to your interests.
* We do **not** have direct access to the data collected by these advertising cookies.

**Your choices:**
* You can **opt out of personalised advertising** by visiting [Google's Ads Settings](https://adssettings.google.com/).
* You can also opt out via the [Network Advertising Initiative opt-out page](http://optout.networkadvertising.org/) or manage cookies directly in your browser settings.
* Opting out does not remove ads entirely — it means ads will no longer be tailored to your interests.

For more information on how Google uses data when you use our site, please visit: [How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).

## 5. Cookies

We use the following types of cookies:

| Type | Purpose | Duration |
|------|---------|----------|
| Session Cookie | Keep you logged in | Browser session |
| Preference Cookie | Remember your theme/language | 1 year |
| Analytics Cookie (Google) | Understand traffic patterns | 2 years |
| Advertising Cookie (Google AdSense) | Serve relevant ads | Up to 2 years |

You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website and game features.

## 6. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures, including bcrypt password hashing and SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmitted between your browser and our servers. However, no internet transmission is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## 7. Children's Privacy

Our games are designed to be enjoyed by users of all ages, including children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without parental consent. If you believe your child has provided personal information on our site, please contact us at **contact@puzzlepk.com** so we can promptly delete it.

## 8. Your Rights

You have the right to request the deletion of your account and associated gameplay data at any time. To do so, please contact us at **contact@puzzlepk.com** or use the account deletion feature in the settings panel.

## 9. Changes to this Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Effective Date." We encourage you to review this page periodically.

## 10. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: **contact@puzzlepk.com**

tutorial.mine.goal_desc: Reveal all safe cells without hitting any mines. The numbers tell you how many mines are adjacent.
tutorial.mine.reveal_desc: Left-click (or tap) a cell to reveal it. The first click is always safe — a blank area will open up.
tutorial.mine.flag_desc: Right-click (or long-press) to place a flag on a suspected mine. Flags prevent accidental reveals.
tutorial.mine.numbers_desc: A number shows how many mines touch that cell. Use them to deduce which cells are safe and which are mines.
tutorial.mine.hint_desc: Stuck? Tap the 💡 Hint button — it safely reveals one guaranteed-safe cell for you.
tutorial.sudoku.goal_desc: Fill a 9×9 grid so every row, column, and 3×3 box contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.
tutorial.sudoku.rules_desc: No digit can repeat in the same row, column, or 3×3 box. Tap a cell and then tap a number to fill it in.
tutorial.sudoku.notes_desc: Enable Notes mode to jot down possible digits in a cell without committing. Great for narrowing down candidates.
tutorial.sudoku.hint_desc: Tap 💡 Hint to reveal one correct digit. Hints use a limited pool — use them wisely!
tutorial.math24.goal_desc: Use all four numbers on the card with any combination of + − × ÷ to make exactly 24.
tutorial.math24.ops_desc: You can use addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Parentheses are applied automatically.
tutorial.math24.select_desc: Tap a number, then tap an operator, then tap another number. Keep combining until you reach 24!
tutorial.math24.timer_desc: Solve as fast as possible to earn maximum stars and XP. Can't solve it? Try Shuffle for a new puzzle.
tutorial.codebreaker.goal_desc: Guess the secret code within the allowed number of attempts. Each guess reveals clues about your accuracy.
tutorial.codebreaker.feedback_desc: 🟢 Green = correct digit in the right position. 🟡 Yellow = correct digit in the wrong position. ⚫ Grey = digit not in the code.
tutorial.codebreaker.strategy_desc: Start with digits that cover many possibilities. Use the clues from each guess to eliminate options.
tutorial.codebreaker.hint_desc: Stuck? Tap 💡 to reveal one correct digit in its exact position. Use hints wisely!
tutorial.watersort.goal_desc: Sort all the colored liquids so each tube contains only one color. All tubes must be pure!
tutorial.watersort.select_desc: Tap a tube to select it (it will lift up), then tap another tube to pour the top color into it.
tutorial.watersort.rules_desc: You can only pour onto a matching color or into an empty tube. You can't pour if the destination is full.
tutorial.watersort.hint_desc: Tap 💡 to see the next recommended pour. Great for when you feel stuck!
tutorial.sokoban.goal_desc: Push all the boxes (📦) onto the target spots (★). When a box lands on a target it turns dark.
tutorial.sokoban.controls_desc: Swipe or tap the directional arrows to move the character. On desktop you can also use arrow keys or WASD.
tutorial.sokoban.rules_desc: Boxes can be pushed but not pulled. Plan ahead — pushing a box into a corner with no target is a dead end!
tutorial.sokoban.undo_desc: Tap ↩ to undo your last move. Tap 💡 for a hint. Both are limited per puzzle, so use them wisely.
tutorial.sliding.goal_desc: Arrange the numbered tiles in order from top-left to bottom-right, leaving the blank space at the end.
tutorial.sliding.move_desc: Tap any tile adjacent to the blank space to slide it in. Only tiles directly next to the gap can move.
tutorial.sliding.strategy_desc: Solve the puzzle row by row from the top. Avoid disturbing rows you've already completed while working on lower ones.
tutorial.sliding.hint_desc: Stuck? Tap 💡 to get a recommended move and find the right direction.
tutorial.tetris.goal_desc: Stack falling pieces to complete full rows — completed rows clear automatically and earn you points. Don't let pieces reach the top!
tutorial.tetris.controls_desc: Swipe left/right to move, swipe up or tap to rotate, swipe down to speed up, double-tap to drop. On desktop use arrow keys.
tutorial.tetris.scoring_desc: Clear multiple rows at once for a massive bonus: 2 rows ×3, 3 rows ×5, 4 rows (Tetris!) ×8.
tutorial.tetris.strategy_desc: Keep your stack flat and fill holes early. Save I-pieces for Tetris clears to maximise your score.
tutorial.hexa.goal_desc: Place hexagonal pieces on the board. Fill complete rows or diagonals to clear them and score points.
tutorial.hexa.place_desc: Drag a piece from the tray at the bottom and drop it onto the board. A preview highlights where it will land.
tutorial.hexa.clear_desc: Clearing multiple lines at once triggers a combo for multiplied points. The more you clear together, the bigger the reward!
tutorial.hexa.end_desc: The game ends when none of the three tray pieces can fit anywhere on the board. Manage your space wisely!
tutorial.gomoku.goal_desc: Be the first to connect five stones in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
tutorial.gomoku.turn_desc: Players alternate placing one stone per turn on any empty intersection. Black moves first.
tutorial.gomoku.defense_desc: Block your opponent's four-in-a-row immediately. Look for double-three or double-four threats to force a win.
tutorial.gomoku.ai_desc: In single-player mode choose Easy, Medium, or Hard AI. Hard AI plans several moves ahead — start with Easy to practice!
tutorial.drop2048.goal_desc: Drop numbered balls and merge matching ones to double their value. Chain merges to reach 2048 and beyond for the highest score!
tutorial.drop2048.drop_desc: Tap or click a column to drop the current ball there. A preview line shows exactly where it will land.
tutorial.drop2048.merge_desc: When two balls with the same number touch they merge instantly: 2+2→4, 4+4→8… all the way to 2048!
tutorial.drop2048.end_desc: The game ends when a column is full and the next ball can't be placed. Watch column heights and spread your drops evenly.
tutorial.block.goal_desc: Place block pieces onto the grid to fill complete rows or columns. Clear lines to score — survive as long as possible!
tutorial.block.place_desc: Drag a piece from the tray at the bottom onto an empty area of the board. Invalid spots are highlighted in red.
tutorial.block.clear_desc: Filling multiple rows or columns simultaneously triggers a combo for bonus points. Plan placements to maximise clears!
tutorial.block.end_desc: When none of the tray pieces can fit anywhere on the board, the game ends. Keep lines clear to preserve space!
tutorial.lightsout.goal_desc: Turn off every light on the board (all cells go dark). When the board is completely unlit, you win!
tutorial.lightsout.toggle_desc: Clicking a light toggles it AND its four orthogonal neighbours simultaneously. This is the core mechanic!
tutorial.lightsout.logic_desc: Every puzzle has an exact solution where each cell is clicked at most once. Extra clicks just undo your progress.
tutorial.lightsout.hint_desc: Stuck? Tap 💡 to highlight the next recommended cell to click and get back on track.

game.nonogram.seo_desc:
About Nonogram

Nonogram is a classic logic puzzle game where you use number clues to reveal a hidden pixel art picture.

How to Play

The numbers on the edges indicate the lengths of consecutive filled cells in that row or column. Use cross-referencing to logically deduce which cells must be filled or left blank.

Features

  • Multiple grid sizes (5x5, 10x10, 15x15, 20x20, 25x25) for all skill levels.
  • All puzzles are uniquely solvable by pure logic.
  • Compete with others online in Speed mode!

tutorial.classic2048.merge_desc: Two tiles with the same number merge into one (2+2=4, 4+4=8...). A new 2 or 4 appears on an empty spot.
